# DropSpher by DigiSpher

> DropSpher is a fast, 100% offline desktop file powerhouse for Windows (with macOS and Linux ready). It processes files locally on the user's computer without uploading confidential data to cloud servers, charging recurring subscriptions, or imposing artificial file size limits.

## 5 Complete Power Suites

### 1. PDF Power Suite
- **PDF to Word (.docx)**: Reconstructs complex digital text-based PDFs into editable Word documents while preserving genuine table structures, column layouts, headers, footers, and standard typography (Arial, Times New Roman, Calibri, Segoe UI).
- **PDF to Images**: High-resolution rendering to PNG or JPEG at 150 DPI HD, 200 DPI, or 300 DPI print-ready quality. Supports custom page ranges (e.g., 1-3, 5) and clean white paper backgrounds.
- **Dual-Engine PDF Compression**: Intelligent stream and font optimization via PikePDF and PyPDF to minimize file sizes without blur.
- **Merge & Split**: Combine multiple documents in custom order via interactive batch queue, or explode multi-page documents into single sheets.
- **Extract Pages & Rotate**: Isolate specific page ranges and fix scan orientation with 90°, 180°, or 270° rotation.
- **Extract Embedded Images & Text**: Pull raw embedded media and extract clean plaintext.

### 2. Image Processing Studio
- **Universal Multi-Format Conversion**: Fast conversion across PNG, JPEG, WEBP, BMP, TIFF, GIF, and ICO.
- **Images to PDF**: Combine multiple photos and captures into a unified, clean PDF.
- **Windows Application Icon Creator (.ico)**: Automatically packages multi-resolution icons (16x16, 32x32, 48x48, 64x64, 128x128, 256x256).
- **Web Favicon Pack Generator**: Builds `favicon.ico`, multi-size PNGs, and a deployment-ready `site.webmanifest`.
- **Smart Lossless & Lossy Compression**: Quality percentage sliders with automatic RGB/RGBA transparency preservation.
- **Image Resizer**: Percentage scaling or precise width/height pixel constraints maintaining aspect ratios.
- **EXIF & Metadata Scrubber**: Strips hidden GPS coordinates, camera serial numbers, device models, and timestamps.

### 3. Video Suite
- **Video Transcoder**: Fast conversion across MP4, MKV, AVI, MOV, WEBM, and GIF using bundled, optimized FFmpeg binaries.
- **Audio Track Extractor**: Rip audio directly into pristine MP3, AAC, WAV, FLAC, or M4A formats.
- **CRF Video Compression**: Reduce file sizes for Slack, Discord, and email attachments with CRF quality presets and resolution downscaling (Original, 1080p, 720p, 480p).
- **Video to Animated GIF**: Convert clips to looping GIFs with framerate controls (10, 15, 20, 24, 30 fps).

### 4. Audio Studio
- **Audio Format Converter**: Transcode high-fidelity audio between MP3, AAC, WAV, FLAC, OGG, and M4A.
- **Audio Bitrate Control**: Compress audio footprints with selectable bitrates (64 kbps voice up to 320 kbps audiophile grade).

### 5. Developer & Data Toolbox
- **CSV to Styled Excel (.xlsx)**: Automated encoding detection (UTF-8, Latin-1, CP1252), delimiter sniffing (comma, semicolon, tab, pipe), intelligent type inference (numbers, dates, booleans), freeze panes, and styled headers.
- **Excel to CSV**: Export worksheets into clean CSV files, with one-click multi-sheet batch export packaged into a ZIP archive.
- **Cryptographic Hash Generator**: Instant MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, and SHA-512 checksums with 1-click clipboard copying.
- **Base64 Encoder / Decoder**: Encode or decode files and text with support for Standard, URL-Safe, and HTML/CSS Data URI formats.
- **JSON Formatter & Validator**: Beautify, validate, or minify complex JSON payloads with customizable indentation (2 spaces, 4 spaces, tabs).
- **Offline QR Code Generator**: Generate high-resolution vector and raster QR codes for URLs, WiFi credentials, and plain text with visual titles.

---

## Architectural & Security Highlights
- **Interactive Batch Queue**: Dedicated queue cards for staging multiple files, tracking payload size, and removing items.
- **Before / After Size Transparency**: Color-coded metrics showing input size, output size, bytes saved, and reduction percentage.
- **Atomic File Safety & In-App Renaming**: Sandboxed temporary write + atomic swap upon success. Original files are never touched on error or cancellation.
- **Built-In Private Analytics**: Local SQLite history tracking completed operations and megabytes saved—100% private to the machine.
- **Commercial Anti-Tamper Hardening**: Enterprise security hardening against memory dumping, dynamic debuggers, and tampering.

---

## System Requirements
- **Operating System**: Windows 10 or Windows 11 (64-bit architecture; macOS & Linux ready)
- **Processor**: Intel or AMD 64-bit CPU
- **Storage**: ~150 MB available local disk space
- **Internet Requirement**: 100% offline for all file processing operations.
